name: pagination
description: Page navigation with previous, next, numbered links, and an ellipsis for long ranges.
purpose: Lets people move through a paged list, table, or catalog without losing their place in the set.
bestFor: docs or archives that split content by page
avoidFor: stepped wizards that need a stepper instead
